title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
summary_zh: 本页展示了‘买椟还珠’的标题画面，一个装饰精美的盒子打开，里面露出一颗发光的珍珠，背景为木质窗格，寓意故事主题。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh: 从前，楚国有个珠宝商人，到郑国去贩卖珠宝，他有一颗十分名贵的珍珠，想卖个好价钱
page_text_en: Once upon a time, there was a jewelry merchant from the State of Chu who went to the State of Zheng to sell jewels. He had a very precious pearl and wanted to sell it for a good price.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了故事的开端：一位楚国珠宝商人带着一颗名贵珍珠前往郑国，希望卖出好价钱。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh:
于是，他精选上等的木料定做了一个小盒子，
还请来高明的雕刻师
page_text_en:
So, he selected high-quality wood to have a small box made,
and also invited a skilled carver.
summary_zh: 商人为了包装珍珠，特意选用上等木料定制小盒子，并请来高明的雕刻师进行制作。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh: 在盒子的外面雕刻上玫瑰花的图案，并镶了一些花花绿绿的小宝石
page_text_en: On the outside of the box, rose patterns were carved, and some colorful little gemstones were inlaid.
summary_zh: 本页展示了珠宝商人精心装饰的盒子，其外表面雕刻有玫瑰花图案，并镶嵌了彩色小宝石，突显其华美。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh: 这个盒子，经过一番装饰显得非常漂亮，多少能衬托出珍珠的名贵
page_text_en: This box, after being decorated, looks very beautiful and can surely highlight the preciousness of the pearl.
summary_zh: 本页展示了一个装饰华丽的盒子，内有发光的珍珠，文字说明盒子的精美装饰能衬托珍珠的珍贵。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh: 楚国的珠宝商人刚一来到集市上，立刻就有很多人被他手中的盒子吸引，把他团团围住
page_text_en: The jewelry merchant from Chu, as soon as he arrived at the market, immediately attracted many people who were drawn to the box in his hand and surrounded him.
summary_zh: 楚国珠宝商人带着精美盒子来到集市，立刻吸引了众多围观者。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh: 有的询问，盒子是用什么制成的，有的问，盒子里面装的是什么
page_text_en: Some asked, 'What is the box made of?' Others asked, 'What is inside the box?'
summary_zh: 集市上的人们被精美的盒子吸引，纷纷询问盒子的材质和里面装的是什么。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh: 但听了他的价钱后都摇摇头
page_text_en: But after hearing his price, they all shook their heads.
summary_zh: 集市上的人们被精美的盒子吸引，但听到珠宝商人开出的高价后，纷纷摇头表示不买。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh: 有一个郑国人挤进人群里
page_text_en: A man from the State of Zheng pushed his way into the crowd.
summary_zh: 一个郑国人挤进围观的人群中，准备与珠宝商人互动。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh:
一看到这个眼花缭乱的盒子就被迷住了，
他连价钱都没讲
page_text_en:
As soon as he saw this dazzling box, he was completely captivated,
He didn't even bother to ask about the price.
summary_zh: 一个郑国人被珠宝商人展示的精美盒子深深吸引，心花怒放，甚至没有询问价格。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh: 扔下钱，拿起盒子，高高兴兴地走了
page_text_en: He threw down the money, picked up the box, and walked away happily.
summary_zh: 一个郑国人买下了精美的盒子，扔下钱后高高兴兴地离开了，没有买里面的珍珠。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh: 没走几步，这个郑国人又转身回来，他走到楚国商人眼前
page_text_en: After taking only a few steps, the man from the State of Zheng turned back and walked up to the merchant from the State of Chu.
summary_zh: 郑国人买下盒子后转身返回，走到楚国商人面前，似乎有话要说。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh: 打开盒子把里面的珍珠拿出来说，与这个珍珠相比，我还是更喜欢这个盒子，说完，就掉头走了
page_text_en: He opened the box, took out the pearl, and said, 'Compared to this pearl, I still prefer the box.' Then he turned and left.
summary_zh: 郑国人打开盒子取出珍珠，表示自己更喜欢盒子，随后转身离开，没有购买珍珠。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh:
珠宝商人拿着珍珠发怔，半天才醒悟过来，
原来此人不识货
page_text_en:
The jewelry merchant held the pearl, stunned, and only after a while realized,
This person simply doesn't know the value of goods.
summary_zh: 珠宝商人拿着珍珠发呆，终于明白买主只看重盒子而不懂珍珠的价值。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh: 珠宝商人得了便宜，拿着珍珠，欢欢喜喜地回楚国去了
page_text_en: The jeweler got a bargain, holding the pearl, happily returned to Chu.
summary_zh: 珠宝商人因郑国人只买盒子而未买珍珠，得以低价收回珍珠，高兴地返回楚国。

title_en: Buying the Box and Returning the Pearl
page_text_ocr_zh:
买椟还珠这则成语就是说：
一个素养不高，缺乏鉴别能力的人，往往会丢掉真正宝贵的东西，而把那些价值并不高的东西当成宝贝，以至于，捡了芝麻丢了西瓜。
page_text_en:
The idiom 'buying the box and returning the pearls' means:
A person with low cultivation and poor discernment often discards truly valuable things, while treating things of little value as treasures, thus, picking up sesame seeds and losing watermelons.
summary_zh: 本页通过一只戴学士帽的兔子讲解，解释了“买椟还珠”这则成语的含义，即因缺乏鉴别能力而舍本逐末，捡了芝麻丢了西瓜。
